title: A chain of kicks
notes: 61 and 4 find empty nests. 26 and 125 both want T1[4]: each takes the slot and pushes the key there over to T2. Then 37 wants T1[4] too. It kicks out 125, which kicks 4 out of T2[0], which goes back to T1[4] and kicks out 37 itself. 37 settles in its T2 nest: three kicks.
